### The Prophet-Mediator
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/prophet-mediator
Passage: Deuteronomy 18:15-22
Points:
- Moses' prediction of a prophet to come lays the groundwork for understanding Jesus' prophetic title.
- Moses and Jesus belong to a unique category of prophets who serve as covenant mediators.
- Both prophets conveyed divine revelation, instituted covenants, and introduced atonement procedures.
- Jesus is far greater than Moses because He is the divine Son of God who unites divinity and humanity.
- Because Christ is the ultimate mediator, believers can enjoy true and lasting peace with God.

### Read the Bible – Deuteronomy 18
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/deut-18-psalm-105-isaiah-45-revelation-15/
Passage: Deuteronomy 18:15-18
Points:
- God forbids pagan divination and occult practices, commanding His people to seek guidance only through His word.
- Israel is given specific tests to distinguish authentic prophetic messages from presumptuous false prophets.
- The prophet fulfills a necessary mediatorial role requested by the terrified Israelites at Mount Sinai.
- While initially fulfilled through the line of Old Testament prophets, the promise points supremely to Jesus Christ.
